turns.doctor_question: Did you have similar troubles with paying attention or staying focused back when you were a child?
turns.patient_response:
Well, yeah, I guess so. Even way back in grade school, you know, definitely before I was 12, my teachers used to tell my parents that I was a bright kid, but I was always daydreaming. And I'd always leave my homework stuffed inside my desk. 

Man, remember those old wooden desks with the tops that lifted up on those squeaky hinges? They had that little groove for your pencil at the top. I used to keep all sorts of junk in there. I had this huge collection of Hot Wheels cars I'd hide in the back of it. The old Redline ones, you know? I had this metallic blue Camaro that was just... it was my absolute favorite. I traded a kid named Jimmy for it at recess one day, gave him two of my duplicate Mustangs for it. Jimmy moved away in fifth grade, actually, went out to Ohio... 

Wait, what was I talking about? Oh, right, my teachers. Yeah, they were always having to come over and remind me to finish my classwork because I'd just be off in my own world instead of doing the assignment.
